name: Passbolt
description: Passbolt Community Edition (CE) API. The JSON API for the open source password manager for teams!
composeYaml:
services:
  passbolt:
    image: 'passbolt/passbolt:latest-ce'
    environment:
      - 'APP_FULL_BASE_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_HOST=mariadb
      - 'DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_USERNAME=${PASSBOLT_USER}'
      - 'DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=${PASSBOLT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DB:-passbolt-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'gpg_volume:/etc/passbolt/gpg'
      - 'jwt_volume:/etc/passbolt/jwt'
    command:
      - /usr/bin/wait-for.sh
      - '-t'
      - '0'
      - 'mariadb:3306'
      - '--'
      - /docker-entrypoint.sh
    depends_on:
      mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:80'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  mariadb:
    image: 'mariadb:11'
    environment:
      - 'MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOTMARIADB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MARIADB_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DB:-passbolt-db}'
      - 'MARIADB_USER=${PASSBOLT_USER}'
      - 'MARIADB_PASSWORD=${PASSBOLT_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'passbolt_mariadb_data:/var/lib/mysql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - healthcheck.sh
        - '--connect'
        - '--innodb_initialized'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
